care.title: Greenhouse Notes
care.intro: Practical tips for keeping your plants healthy and thriving at home
body: Rare aroids are sensitive to excess water. Let the soil dry well between waterings and always check its condition before watering again
Humidity is especially important for tropical plants. A humidifier, enclosed cabinet, or consistently humid environment can help maintain better conditions
New leaves are a good sign of healthy growth. If growth slows down, check the light, watering routine, and humidity around the plant

about.title: A small plant house
about.intro: Understory began in 2019 and grew into a greenhouse near Portland
body: We sell plants only once they have a healthy, well-developed root system. Cuttings are never sold as established plants
Every order is packed specifically for the plant, taking its size, condition, and journey into account to help it travel safely
We intentionally grow in small batches so every plant receives enough time, attention, and proper care before leaving the greenhouse

guarantee.title: 90-Day Guarantee
guarantee.intro: If your plant doesn’t settle in within 90 days, we’ll help get it back on track.
body: Contact support with your order number so we can quickly review the details and help with the next steps
The guarantee covers root development and normal shipping stress, including the plant's natural adjustment to a new environment
If a replacement is needed, it will come from the next available batch of the same or a comparable plant

shipping.title: Climate-smart shipping
shipping.intro: Every order is carefully prepared to reduce shipping stress and keep your plants safe.
body: We ship Monday–Wednesday to minimize weekend transit and warehouse time, helping plants arrive in the best possible condition.
Seasonal protection is selected based on the destination, weather, and current shipping conditions to keep your plant safe throughout its journey.
Orders over €150 ship free. Smaller orders have a flat €18 shipping fee, keeping delivery simple and predictable.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: A few answers to help you choose, order, and care for your plant.
body: How do I choose the right plant? Each listing includes light, size, care, and other useful details.
Are your plants healthy when shipped? Every plant is checked and carefully prepared before shipping.
How are plants packaged? Each plant is securely prepared and packaged for safe transit.

footer.description: A small plant house for anyone willing to wait for the right specimen
